evidence: Running `bash run_repro.sh` prints the hard-coded Real-IAD categories from `codebase/src/anomalib/data/datasets/image/realiad.py` and shows they do not match the 30-category list quoted in `bug_report.txt`. The script exits with status 1 and the log reports 20 missing categories and 20 extra categories.
steps: Read `bug_report.txt` and the Real-IAD source in `codebase/src/anomalib/data/datasets/image/realiad.py`.
Extracted the `CATEGORIES` tuple from the source file.
Compared it to the Real-IAD category list quoted in the report.
Observed a mismatch and a non-zero exit from `bash run_repro.sh`.
